melder.aether.spellbook.spellframe_kind..label: spellframe_kind
melder.aether.spellbook.spellframe_kind..role: Module holding the SpellframeKind enum that a binding records for its spellframe.
responsibilities: exports SpellframeKind for Bind, Spell, Phase 3 and the crystallizer

melder.aether.spellbook.spellframe_kind..label: SpellframeKind
melder.aether.spellbook.spellframe_kind..role: The kind of spellframe a Spell was bound under: none (no frame), category (a string label), contract (a typing.Protocol the spell was checked against).
responsibilities: names the three frame kinds Bind._classify_spellframe assigns; value == name so crystals carry the name
read by CompilerPhase3 to decide what an annotation may match: a category never provides, a contract's implementers do
recorded by SpellCrystal (spellframe_kind) and re-hydrated by RestoreEngine and GraftRunner
